resources.string: Automatically skip opening ads in apps
Find and tap ad skip buttons when you open an app.
Turn on an app below to leave its ads untouched.
ArkUI reads on-screen controls to find and tap opening-ad skip buttons. Processing stays on this device. Enable or disable it in Settings → Special features → Ad skipper.

Only checks the first 10 seconds after an app enters the foreground. Built-in rules look for Chinese and English ad skip buttons in the upper corners. Ads without accessible skip buttons may need to be skipped manually. No screen contents are saved or uploaded.
